caption: Component Settings now shows an FDTD backend picker next to Recalculate, defaulting to the free local Meep (Docker) backend.
Selecting Tidy3D (cloud) without an API key shows an actionable hint pointing to Settings → Tidy3D Cloud.
Recalculating via Tidy3D first shows the estimated FlexCredit cost and waits for explicit confirmation before submitting the cloud job.
The new Settings → Tidy3D Cloud page stores the API key shared by the FDTD S-matrix backend and the Tidy3D mode solver.
